column1: # Pre-registered manifest — depth-3 post-fix ESTIMATION arm. Written BEFORE the
# first cell. Separate arm, separate results file; nothing earlier is re-run.
# PROVENANCE (recorded before the run, per review):
#   repo HEAD f61de85 + uncommitted Sources/swiftstar-agenttest/main.swift
#   ds4 pin   1a2dddf (divergence #14)
#   harness   sha256:9466aa2807c90d34...   engine sha256:af8f1e8babab54fd...
#   Follow-up wording: PLURAL (the shipped default). Byte-identical to what the
#   plural-fix arm ran; the AGENTTEST_SINGULAR_FOLLOWUP switch added afterwards
#   does not alter the default path. NO harness changes during this run.
# WHY THIS IS NOT THE EXPERIMENT I FIRST PROPOSED.
# I intended to run depth-3 at larger n to test "is depth-3 stuck". A review of
# the five failing plural-fix depth-3 captures answered that from disk, at zero
# engine cost: NONE of them is "emitted fewer files than diagnosed". The Block B
# failure signature — headingless turn 1, singular follow-up, one file, twice —
# does not occur once. Four are content/diagnosis failures (talked itself out of
# base.html; the naive datetime.now default_factory timezone trap; an <html> tag
# added without lang="en"; a redirect without status_code=303) and one is a
# format collapse. So the delivery limit is fixed and depth-3's residual is a
# DIFFERENT limit. That question is settled; re-running it would re-derive it.
# Two further findings from that review shape this design:
#   1. POWER. Against Block B's frozen depth-3 baseline of 8/18, detecting
#      44%->70% by Fisher needs n=367 and asymptotes near 0.60 power even at
#      n=200. No affordable n can confirm a modest improvement. At n=40 this is
#      an ESTIMATION instrument, not a hypothesis test, and is designed as one.
#   2. DEPTH IS CONFOUNDED WITH DEFECT DIFFICULTY. depth-3 uniquely contains the
#      timezone trap, the hardest content defect in the corpus. If per-defect
#      difficulty were uniform, depth-3's 58% would predict depth-2 ~70%; the
#      observed depth-2 is 100%. So the 95/63/44 profile is defect identity, not
#      a file-count slope. NO n fixes this. Answering the depth question cleanly
#      needs a `depth-3-easy` fixture (three files, three easy defects) that
#      does not exist. This arm therefore makes NO depth-slope claim.
# DESIGN. depth-3 x rounds=2 x seeds 24-63 (n=40, PRIMARY, estimation)
#         depth-2 x rounds=2 x seeds 24-31 (n=8, regression tripwire)
# Seeds 24-63 are disjoint from every prior use ON THESE FIXTURES: 1-3 (P17),
# 4-23 (Block B and the plural-fix arm), 97-99 (preflight, plausible-wrong-fix
# only), 900 (arm-switch plumbing test, depth-3).
# Note 42 falls inside this range and WAS used before — by P20's live
# orchestrate run and by Block A. That is a different tier entirely (directive
# mode, Laguna S, the roadmap spec), not this fixture family, so it is not a
# collision and seed 42 is kept rather than skipped. Skipping it would put a
# hole in the range for no reason and invite the question later.
# PRIMARY ENDPOINT: the depth-3 post-fix pass rate with a Wilson 95% interval.
# The interval IS the deliverable. There is no pooled multi-file endpoint —
# depth-2 and depth-3 are now known to fail for different reasons, so pooling
# them would average two unrelated quantities. The 19/24 pooled near-miss from
# the plural-fix arm is DEAD and is not revisited; re-running until a pooled
# endpoint clears its bar is the trap this whole campaign exists to avoid.
# DECISION RULES, fixed before the first cell:
#  1. [the ONLY alpha=0.05 test in this experiment] Improvement confirmed iff
#     >=30/40 (75%; Fisher vs 8/18 gives p=0.036). Stated in advance: this
#     threshold has 0.84 power if the truth is 0.80 but only 0.31 if it is 0.70,
#     so it can fire ONLY for a large effect. Failing to fire is not evidence of
#     no effect.
#  2. No meaningful improvement iff the Wilson upper bound < 0.64 (<= ~20/40).
#  3. Otherwise the verdict IS the interval: "post-fix depth-3 sits at [L, U],
#     and the fix did not lift it into the depth-2 regime."
#  4. MECHANISTIC SECONDARY, and the real test of the hypothesis — falsifiable
#     at any n. Classify every failing capture into {fewer-files-than-diagnosed,
#     wrong-file-set/diagnosis, content, format-collapse}. PRE-REGISTERED
#     PREDICTION: delivery-class ("fewer files than diagnosed") <= 1 failure.
#     More than 1 refutes the claim that the plural fix extinguished the
#     delivery defect, whatever the pass rate does.
#  5. TRIPWIRE: depth-2 <= 5/8 flags a regression (P(<=5 | p=0.95) ~ 0.006).
#     Otherwise reported descriptively only — n=8 cannot tell 0.85 from 1.0.
#  6. VOIDS excluded from denominators and left re-runnable, as before. If voids
#     exceed 15% of attempted cells the run is declared COMPROMISED and is not
#     analyzed. Format-collapse cells are tabulated in the format category
#     whether they land as `fail` (contractNotFollowed) or as a V6 void.
# WHAT THIS CANNOT CONCLUDE: confirmation of a modest (44->58-70%) improvement;
# anything separating file count from defect difficulty; anything about WHY the
# content failures happen.
# Runner: EXP_MANIFEST=<this> \
#   EXP_RESULTS=docs/superpowers/research/experiment-results-depth3-estimation.tsv \
#   python3 Tools/run-experiment.py
